purpose: A46 rule 9 runtime record for the DeltaAI training container: library versions and compile policy, read out of the SIF itself.
measured_host: gh-login03.delta.ncsa.illinois.edu (DeltaAI login node, reached 2-hop via pronghorn)
measured_by: read-only: sha256sum on the SIF, then `apptainer exec <sif> python3` importing each module
cost: login-node only; no job submitted, no GPU time consumed

compile_policy.reading: suppress_errors=false means Dynamo raises on a compile failure rather than silently degrading to eager, which is the direction A46 rule 9 requires. It does NOT close rule 9's other half: the trainer itself must raise, and train_HyenaTransgenic.py line 317 currently only warns. That is a code gap, unchanged by this measurement.

cross_checks.A44_triple: A44 (:923) records torch 2.14.0a0+4fdf77b940.nv26.08, transformers 4.57.6, accelerate 1.15.0. All three match the values read out of the container here, by a different method on a different day.
cross_checks.sif_size_vs_budget: 11,120,398,336 B agrees with the 11.12 GB SIF term in the 51.53 GB hashing budget enumerated for the 1700 s external-timeout analysis.

notes.apptainer: /usr/bin/apptainer and /usr/bin/singularity are on PATH on the login node; no module load is needed. A42's 'no apptainer module' note means there is no environment module, not that the binary is unavailable.
notes.pysam: pysam is NOT in the container. mvp_build_c0lite.py depends on pysam, so that step must run where pysam exists -- pronghorn's transgenic-revision env has pysam 0.23.3 -- not inside this SIF.
notes.duckdb: duckdb 1.5.5 inside the container is the same version as the working install on pgl-gpu.

not_measured.seed123_container: transgenic-ngc.sif (NGC 25.06, torch 2.8.0a0, sha256 3b242b339f59a8f8...) was not re-hashed in this pass; seed 123 runs on that image per A44/A45.
